Analyzed datasets and disease/genotype/age strata separately; subsequently correlated AD scores with module eigengenes using Pearson correlation.
review.implementation_scope_note: Scoped original scDRS1.0.0/1.0.1/1.0.2 workflows and separate native numerical components are implemented; read SCDRS_INTEGRATION.md. Tested release tags do not establish an author source commit or reconstruct unreported commands. Keep each dataset and stratum separate; scDRS does not automatically remove batch effects. Supply the selected curated gene-set release. Ordinary module-score Pearson coefficients are a distinct step from the scDRS correlation Monte Carlo output; the existing StatisticalTests.correlation Java API is available for explicitly aligned vectors.

review.use_summary: Used scDRS1.0.2 on PBMC and MS-lesion datasets with top1000 cross-population MAGMA genes outside chr6:25-34Mb MHC. Computed1000 control scores; included genes-per-cell, age and sex covariates; performed cell-type association tests and BH correction across cell types within each dataset, declaring FDR<0.05.
review.implementation_scope_note: Scoped original scDRS1.0.0/1.0.1/1.0.2 workflows and separate native numerical components are implemented; read SCDRS_INTEGRATION.md. Tested release tags do not establish an author source commit or reconstruct unreported commands. Provide explicitly prepared disease genes and covariates; immune-cell removal and MHC exclusion are separate input decisions. Choose one BH family across all tested cell types in each dataset, with strict q<0.05. A successful synthetic control does not reproduce the cohort or biological findings.
